name: dev-prune
description: Teaches Claude the dev-prune (devp) CLI: how to reclaim disk space by deleting dependency and build directories a lockfile can rebuild, how to put them back, the safety rules it will not cross, its exit codes, its --json contract, and its troubleshooting tree. Use when asked to clean or prune node_modules / .venv / target / vendor, restore project dependencies, find where the disk went, or diagnose devp itself.
